title: Days an Additional Driver Fee is Charged for on a Car Rental Agreement
content:
On the Car Rental Rate Classes, the days an additional driver fee is charged for are counted by the length of the agreement, that length being the booked period from the scheduled collection moment to the scheduled return moment.

**The schedule of charged days.**

| The agreement books | The days the fee is charged for |
|---|---|
| 14 or more rental days | The first 14 days, and no day beyond them |
| 7 to 13 rental days | The first 7 days in full, and each further booked day at 0.5 of a day |
| Fewer than 7 rental days | Every booked rental day |

**Read as three statements.** Where the booked period runs to 14 rental days or more, the count stops at 14 however much longer the agreement runs, so an agreement of 14 days and an agreement of 30 days are each charged for 14 days. Where it runs from 7 to 13 rental days, the first 7 days count in full and every day after the seventh counts as half a day, at 0.5 of a day each. Where it runs to fewer than 7 rental days, every booked rental day counts in full.

**Both sides of the two thresholds, on hypothetical booked periods.**

- A booked period of 6 rental days counts 6 days in full.
- A booked period of exactly 7 rental days falls in the middle band with no further day beyond the seventh, and so counts 7 days.
- A booked period of 10 rental days counts the first 7 in full and the remaining 3 at 0.5 of a day each, giving 8.5 days.
- A booked period of 13 rental days counts the first 7 in full and the remaining 6 at 0.5 of a day each, giving 10 days.
- A booked period of exactly 14 rental days counts 14 days.
- A booked period of 21 rental days counts 14 days, the days beyond the fourteenth counting for nothing.
